notes: §1985:VIII.1.3.4 GRL2.4, permanent error: 30 (no further information), 35 for OPEN INPUT, I-O or EXTEND of a non-optional absent file, 37 for an open mode the file will not support, 38 'an OPEN statement is attempted on a file previously closed with lock', 39 a fixed-attribute conflict. FileConnector.Open with the connectors' OpenCore (FileSupport.Probe for presence, PermitsWrite for 37, FixedAttributeConflict for 39) and FileRegistry.CloseWithLock/SharedOpenAttempt for 38 set these; CLOSE WITH LOCK is refused at 2023 (COBOL0902) and runs to 38 at 85 and 2002 (edition arm). Probes at --std 85 (work-rd-04/c6/p1.cob and the witness): 35 for non-optional absent indexed INPUT and I-O (the witness: relative INPUT, I-O, EXTEND), with the USE ON INPUT declarative run and READ after the failed OPEN -> 47; OPTIONAL absent INPUT/EXTEND/I-O -> 05 (READ -> 10), not 35; 38 after CLOSE WITH LOCK for sequential (INPUT and EXTEND) and indexed (I-O); 39 for an indexed file reopened with its record key at another offset and for the same file opened as relative; 37 for OPEN OUTPUT and EXTEND on a read-only file, INPUT on it 00. Not provoked: 30 (no host fault reachable from COBOL source) and 37 for INPUT on a write-only file (Windows).

next.reason: 30, 35, 37 a) and 39 carry over (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1, GR5, GR6, GR7; OPEN §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10 sets '39', GR16 sets '37' for an unsupported I-O open). But 1985 'I-O Status = 38 ... an OPEN statement is attempted on a file previously closed with lock' (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 GR4) has no 2023 rule: §2023:E.2 lists 'The WITH LOCK phrase of the CLOSE statement and the related File Status of 38' as removed. 37 also gains an authority case and 39 DELETE FILE, neither reachable from 1985 source.
